from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
from qiskit.opflow import PauliSumOp, I, X, Z
import numpy as np

def solve_tfim_5site_obc():
    # Define the Hamiltonian
    J = 1.0
    h_values = np.arange(0.10, 2.51, 0.1)
    observables_accuracy = []
    phase_classification_accuracy = []

    obs1 = sum(Z^Z for Z in [Z^I^I^I^I, I^Z^I^I^I, I^I^Z^I^I, I^I^I^Z^I, I^I^I^I^Z])
    obs2 = sum(X for X in [X^I^I^I^I, I^X^I^I^I, I^I^X^I^I, I^I^I^X^I, I^I^I^I^X])
    
    # Run VQE for each h value

    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=100)
